key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased to MEUR 86.97 in Q1 2026, up 22.4% year‑on‑year.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table and accompanying text (revenue row, Q1 2026 column).

key_information_units.information: Net profit rose to MEUR 5.09 in Q1 2026, a 25.7% increase over Q1 2025, with a profit margin of 5.8%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Net profit row) and text 'In the first three months of 2026, the Group's net profit amounted to MEUR 5.1...'.

key_information_units.information: EBITDA fell to MEUR 3.00 in Q1 2026, down 50.2% year‑on‑year; EBITDA margin declined to 3.5%. The figure excludes a preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (EBITDA row) and text 'During Q1 2026 EBITDA reached MEUR 3.0 (a decrease of 50.2% compared to the same period last year). In Q1 2026 EBITDA excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB.'

key_information_units.information: On 16 January 2026 VILVI Group acquired 100% of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB, adding canned‑milk and butter production; the company will be integrated to capture synergies and expand whey‑processing capacity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 1 – Main events during 3 months of 2026 (acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB on 16 Jan 2026) and subsequent integration description.

key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production began at the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA factory in Bauska, Latvia, creating over 100 jobs, with planned output of 18 kt/year for export to more than 40 markets; the facility was awarded third place in the 2025 Latvian Construction Awards.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia' and the Latvian Construction Awards mention.

key_information_units.information: Key operating‑segment developments: fresh‑milk products revenue grew 73.4% to MEUR 12.75, dry‑milk products rose 126.9% to MEUR 24.66, cheese‑segment revenue fell 28.8% to MEUR 37.64, and a new canned‑milk segment contributed MEUR 11.92 (14% of total revenue).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by operating segments table (Q1 2024‑2026) and note on canned‑milk consolidation from 2026-01-01.

key_information_units.information: Net financial debt increased to MEUR 83.43 at 31 March 2026, up 89.7% compared with Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Net financial debt row).

key_information_units.information: Purchased milk (basic indicators) reached 155,954 t in Q1 2026, up 54.2% year‑on‑year.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Purchased basic indicators milk, in tons) row.

key_information_units.information: VILVI discontinued the use of transparent plastic lids for its yogurts as part of a sustainability initiative.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section: 'Atsisakome skaidrių plastikinių dangtelių VILVI We are discontinuing the use of transparent plastic lids for VILVI yogurts.'
